episodes.title: Happiness
episodes.summary: After a failed suicide attempt, Ryan notices that he sees the neighbor's dog as a person dressed dog costume.

episodes.title: Trust
episodes.summary: Wilfred comes into Ryan's yard, so the two go to the beach, as Wilfred has always wanted to swim in the ocean. After Ryan lets him, the two bond more, and spend the day hanging out. When Ryan drops Wilfred off, Jenna asks Ryan to trick Wilfred into going to the dentist to get his teeth cleaned. Ryan reluctantly accepts, and tricks Wilfred by telling him they're going to the movies, and Wilfred is mad at Ryan. While under anesthesia, Wilfred reveals a horrifying secret about Jenna.

episodes.title: Fear
episodes.summary: Ryan gets his wallet back (that's the good news) when his malevolent, porn-addicted neighbor Spencer (Ethan Suplee) shows up. The bad news: Spencer's looking for answers about who broke into his house. He's also looking for blood.

episodes.title: Acceptance
episodes.summary: Ryan feels obligated to repay his sister's help, however inappropriate, and therefore must shortly hand Wilfred into Darryl's daycare. The dog feels neglected and behaves strangely depressed.

episodes.title: Respect
episodes.summary: Ryan and Wilfred volunteer at a hospice and discover Wilfred may have a remarkable secret talent.

episodes.title: Conscience
episodes.summary: Wilfred persuades Ryan to help him get rid of Jenna's boyfriend.

episodes.title: Pride
episodes.summary: Wilfred's pursuit of a new love interest forces Ryan to swallow his pride - among other things.

episodes.title: Anger
episodes.summary: Ryan has a guilt complex over the death of his childhood dog, and Wilfred, upon learning of it, goes to otherworldly lengths to help Ryan discover the truth about how the pooch passed on. Meanwhile, Kristen throws a party for her boss.

episodes.title: Compassion
episodes.summary: Ryan's resentment of his eccentric mother is exacerbated when Wilfred starts treating her like the mum he never had.

episodes.title: Isolation
episodes.summary: Wilfred uses Ryan's unhealthy habit of isolating as a means to rid himself of a neighborhood pest.

episodes.title: Doubt
episodes.summary: Ryan begins to suspect that his friendship with Wilfred may be self-destructive.

episodes.title: Sacrifice
episodes.summary: Just as Ryan finds happiness in his life, Wilfred begs him to sacrifice it for a larger purpose.

episodes.title: Identity
episodes.summary: Ryan ignores Wilfred's advice, creating an existential crisis for both of them.

episodes.title: Progress
episodes.summary: Ryan learns that life is much more challenging without Wilfred around.

episodes.title: Letting Go
episodes.summary: Wilfred is tired of Ryan only thinking of himself, and wants their 'bromance' to go both ways. So in exchange for Wilfred helping him to break up Jenna and Drew, Ryan signs them up for an agility contest.

episodes.title: Dignity
episodes.summary: Ryan has to deal with new problems when Wilfred becomes popular.

episodes.title: Guilt
episodes.summary: Ryan is forced to intervene when Wilfred becomes embattled with an unlikely foe.

episodes.title: Now
episodes.summary: A traumatic experience creates unexpected consequences for Ryan and Wilfred.

episodes.title: Control
episodes.summary: Ryan's plans to introduce Amanda to Jenna are complicated by Wilfred.

episodes.title: Avoidance
episodes.summary: Wilfred and Ryan's friendship is threatened during a sticky encounter.

episodes.title: Truth
episodes.summary: Wilfred's nemesis returns with an offer that rocks Ryan's world.

episodes.title: Service
episodes.summary: An impromptu road trip leaves Wilfred, Ryan, and his family in peril.

episodes.title: Honesty
episodes.summary: Ryan and Wilfred go to extraordinary lengths to help Jenna's career.

episodes.title: Questions
episodes.summary: Ryan attempts to discover the truth about Wilfred through self-examination.

episodes.title: Resentment
episodes.summary: Ryan's jealousy causes Wilfred to derail Jenna and Drew's wedding.

episodes.title: Secrets
episodes.summary: Wilfred and Ryan are confronted by shocking existential questions about life and love.

episodes.title: Uncertainty
episodes.summary: Ryan and Wilfred search for Wilfred's original owner.

episodes.title: Comfort
episodes.summary: Ryan befriends Wilfred's enemy—the mailman.

episodes.title: Suspicion
episodes.summary: Ryan distrusts his sister's new love interest.

episodes.title: Sincerity
episodes.summary: Ryan takes Wilfred to a dog training class in the hopes of winning over a girl.

episodes.title: Shame
episodes.summary: Ryan finds a roommate with Wilfred's help.

episodes.title: Delusion
episodes.summary: Wilfred forces Ryan to collaborate on a birthday gift for Jenna.

episodes.title: Intuition
episodes.summary: Wilfred leads Ryan on a crime-fighting caper.

episodes.title: Perspective
episodes.summary: Ryan tries progressive psychotherapy to better understand a past trauma.

episodes.title: Confrontation
episodes.summary: Wilfred crashes Christmas and pits Ryan against his family.

episodes.title: Distance
episodes.summary: A struggle emerges between Ryan, Wilfred and an old friend.

episodes.title: Stagnation
episodes.summary: Wilfred pursues a forbidden love.

episodes.title: Heroism
episodes.summary: Ryan is put in danger as Wilfred pursues the path to valor.

episodes.title: Regrets
episodes.summary: Jenna forbids Ryan from seeing Wilfred when he needs him most.

episodes.title: Amends
episodes.summary: When Ryan's reality is upended, he gets a second chance to make things right.

episodes.title: Consequences
episodes.summary: Disaster strikes when Ryan and Wilfred get an unwanted guest on their camping trip.

episodes.title: Loyalty
episodes.summary: Ryan and Wilfred take sides in Kristen's custody battle.

episodes.title: Answers
episodes.summary: Ryan subjects Wilfred to a scientific study with unsettling results.

episodes.title: Forward
episodes.summary: Ryan and Wilfred have drastically different accounts of the same disturbing incident.

episodes.title: Patterns
episodes.summary: Ryan finds he has been sucked into the endgame.

episodes.title: Responsibility
episodes.summary: Ryan attempts to help his mother adapt to her new life whilst Wilfred confronts a new enemy.

episodes.title: Courage
episodes.summary: Wilfred attempts to convince Ryan to not tell Jenna some sensitive information.

episodes.title: Resistance
episodes.summary: Ryan sees his hopes fading as he has to deal with some difficult challenges.

episodes.title: Happiness
episodes.summary: Ryan finally learns the truth about Wilfred.
